archer: ARCHER: green tactical leather vest over ivory fitted shirt, forest green short cloak, brown leather bracers, quiver and a long elegant wood bow. Ready archer stance with left hand visibly gripping bow and right hand drawing an arrow at lower chest level; bowstring clear of face, green arrow glint below shoulders.
assassin: ASSASSIN: dark plum fitted high collar battle outfit, crossed practical leather straps, short asymmetric dark navy cloak, red accents. Low agile twisting ready stance, TWO short daggers visibly held one in each gloved hand, red blade trails below shoulders, no mask over face.
priest: PRIEST: ivory and antique gold split long clerical coat over muted blue inner tunic, neat shoulder mantle, healing satchel, gold waist clasp. One hand grips a slender ceremonial staff, other open palm offering golden holy light low near waist. Calm confident protective battle-ready pose, no hat.
paladin: PALADIN: heavy articulated silver-white armor with gold borders over blue military tunic, short white half-cape. One hand grips a long sword, other arm firmly carries a LARGE gold-and-ivory shield via visible grip/straps. Strong angled guarding stance, rounded pauldrons, gold defensive halo below face, no helmet.
berserker: SWORDSAGE (internal id berserker): Chinese xianxia swordsage, flowing WHITE crossover long sword robe with restrained blue-jade trim, burgundy sash and light leather wrist guards. Right hand holds elegant straight jian, left hand makes two-finger sword gesture at chest level, three smaller spectral flying swords orbit behind the lower torso, blood-red and white sword energy below head. SAME short chestnut hairstyle, not long-haired, not a barbarian or axe fighter.
marksman: MARKSMAN: single-shoulder blue and navy long marksman's jacket with antique gold hardware, leather bracers and long precision sniper bow. One small hinged monocular sight attached near temple, flipped outward so BOTH amber eyes remain visible. Hands firmly grip bow and poised arrow at lower chest. Golden aim lines below shoulders, controlled precise stance.
ranger: RANGER: emerald green asymmetric mountain short cloak over leather ranger vest, brown straps and arm guards. A realistic small FALCON perches on padded left forearm, its wings partly open; right hand grips a lowered curved bow. Wind-swept agile torso turn, green gust ribbon below face. Falcon stays below shoulder and never covers head.
archmage: ARCHMAGE: ornate deep purple wide-sleeved long wizard coat with ivory inner robe, gold rune edging and turquoise small fasteners. One hand grips a tall staff outside face area, other palm directs floating open grimoire at waist level. Deep violet lightning and geometric magic circle below shoulders, dynamic casting pose. No hat or different hair.
summoner: SUMMONER: orange multi-pocket short hooded robe/jacket with folded-down hood, deep violet lining and leather contract satchel, green glass charm. Hand grips short summoning staff, other open palm calls compact flame spirit and small stone golem beside LOWER torso, both clearly companions not scenery. Orange contract rings below shoulders, confident commanding posture.
ninja: NINJA: slate gray-blue fitted crossover ninja combat tunic, dark indigo trousers, practical forearm wraps, low-profile belt and pouches. One hand grips a black steel kunai with ring pommel, other hand makes a credible two-finger seal at chest level. Angled agile stance, muted blue speed ribbon below shoulders. No forehead T-band, no face mask, preserve all hair.
shadowdancer: SHADOWDANCER: deep purple and magenta asymmetric short battle jacket over fitted dark shirt, practical leather belts, flowing dance sash. Both hands hold small daggers with poison-green blade glow; graceful twisting combat stance. ONE translucent purple shadow echo of THIS SAME adventurer behind the lower shoulder/body, its head kept small offset outside the main face, no separate opaque person. Green-purple trails do not cover main face.
bishop: BISHOP: ivory-gold broad-collar ritual long coat with muted lavender lining, compact HIGH clerical mitre/crown fitted naturally over same hairstyle, entire crown visible inside frame. Left hand holds a closed ornate holy book at waist, right hand grips golden crozier. Gold translucent protective barrier arc near lower torso, firm benevolent ready stance. Keep main face at exactly same scale and near same location; visible chestnut fringe below mitre.
inquisitor: INQUISITOR: orange-gold asymmetric sleeveless judgment long vest over ivory high collar and navy battle tunic, armored gloves, leather belt, antique gold trim. Hand visibly grips long ceremonial judgment spear diagonally, other hand commands downward orange-gold light column at outside lower edge. Stern confident advancing ready stance, no headgear, light never over face.
